stage0052_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$フェルト$$
「The dimensional boundary is already stable」

stage0052_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$ラッセ$$
「So this is after a $$時空震動$$ hit, huh」

stage0052_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「But $$時空震動$$s and dimensional tremors
　only happen before the boundary is
　fully fixed, so maybe we should be glad」

stage0052_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$ミレイナ$$
「There's a metal reading in the ice ahead, desu!」

stage0052_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「This area's clear of the Federation
　and Neo Zeon's combat zone too」

stage0052_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Then we should assume that ice block
　was thrown here by a $$時空震動$$」

stage0052_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$フェルト$$
「$$ブラックゲッター$$ has launched」

stage0052_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Hey, $$スメラギ$$,
　I'll go recover that ice block myself」

stage0052_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「What's gotten into you?
　Don't tell me you're part of that
　rumored Volunteer Club too?」

stage0052_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Sorry, but I'm too old to pass for a student」

stage0052_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Let's both drop the age talk.
　It's getting depressing」

stage0052_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ミレイナ$$
「So it bothered you too, Noriega and Colonel Katsuragi」

stage0052_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ラッセ$$
「I think you're both aging just fine」

stage0052_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Thanks, $$ラッセ$$.
　Still, it's hard not to worry about it」

stage0052_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Then how about the $$エタニティ・フラット$$?
　That'll stop aging for good」

stage0052_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「A world with no need to think about
　anti-aging just sounds dull」

stage0052_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Exactly.
　A woman's worth only rises by
　overcoming hardship」

stage0052_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Now that's spirit.
　I could fall for you ladies」

stage0052_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Don't tease your elders.
　Well then, I'll leave the recovery to you」

stage0052_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Got it.
　Can't lose to the young ones just yet」

stage0052_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$竜馬$$
「This thing's pretty huge.
　Hard to tell what's buried inside it」

stage0052_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$フェルト$$
「Be careful, $$竜馬$$!
　The dimensional boundary's warping again!」

stage0052_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$フェルト$$
「Something's closing in on this area fast!」

stage0052_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$竜馬$$
「You were after that ice block too!?」

stage0052_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$グーラ$$
「...I owe you no answer to that」

stage0052_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Angry, are you?
　But I'm not the one who'll face you」

stage0052_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$...
　What are you even doing this for...」

stage0052_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Think about it later!
　A $$時空震動$$'s about to hit!」

stage0052_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「That's the 《$$インベーダー#keyword$$》...
　the worst enemy, drawn to Earth by Getter rays」

stage0052_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ラッセ$$
「Damn it!
　We thought we wiped them out during
　the $$再世戦争$$, but they're back!」

stage0052_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, launch!
　If the enemy is $$インベーダー#keyword$$s, it's kill or
　be killed!」

stage0052_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$カイエン$$
「And there's a ton of them too!」

stage0052_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$シモン$$
「Watch yourselves!
　$$インベーダー#keyword$$s overwhelm you with numbers!」

stage0052_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$刹那$$
「Did that man calling himself $$アドヴェント$$
　mean to warn us of the $$インベーダー#keyword$$'s attack?」

stage0052_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$桂$$
「Hey, hey!
　So you're saying that guy knew
　they were coming!?」

stage0052_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Foreseeing the future...
　Just how far does that Chrono outfit's reach go...」

stage0052_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$カレン$$
「We can't let them through to Earth!
　We'll stop them here for sure!」

stage0052_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Bring it on!
　If they've come back again,
　there's only one thing to do!」

stage0052_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$竜馬$$
「This time I'll smash them
　until they stop breathing for good!!」

stage0052_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Careful.
　Another $$時空震動$$ is coming」

stage0052_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$アスカ$$
「What is that thing!
　Is it even alive!?」

stage0052_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$シモン$$
「Don't judge them by our standards!
　They've evolved into monsters that
　exist to destroy anything they see!」

stage0052_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$竜馬$$
「The $$インベーダー#keyword$$ is after the Getter!
　I'll take that one on myself!」

stage0052_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$タケル$$
「That's reckless!
　Fighting a giant $$インベーダー#keyword$$ alone!」

stage0052_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't know why,
　but I just felt like doing something reckless」

stage0052_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$竜馬$$
「I get it now.
　How $$葵$$ and the others felt, getting their fire back」

stage0052_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Same goes for me!
　Something hot's welling up from deep
　inside me, and it won't stop!!」

stage0052_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ミレイナ$$
「It's been swallowed by the $$インベーダー#keyword$$, desu!」

stage0052_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Even the Getter can't take this...!」

stage0052_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$竜馬$$
「You're too soft, $$インベーダー#keyword$$!
　Don't think eating me ends in just a stomachache!!」

stage0052_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$バナージ$$
「That guy... he's out of his mind...」

stage0052_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$宗介$$
「So he is not a man who dies, even when killed」

stage0052_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$n
「But $$ブラックゲッター$$ has taken damage too!」

stage0052_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$キタン$$
「Not like you, $$竜馬$$!
　You, struggling like this!」

stage0052_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「But it's fine now!
　We're here!」

stage0052_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$マオ$$
「So that's $$キタン$$, the vanguard captain,
　and $$ヨーコ$$ the sniper, of Dai-Gurren Brigade」

stage0052_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$クルツ$$
「These are reinforcements I'd love to get close to!」

stage0052_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$キタン$$
「What was that, huh!
　That's your greeting after all this time!?」

stage0052_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Shut it!
　You're the ones who butted into
　someone else's fight!」

stage0052_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$キタン$$
「Don't act tough!
　What're you gonna do with that busted Getter!?」

stage0052_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$竜馬$$
「I know that already.
　You're not the only ones who came here!」

stage0052_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$弁慶$$
「Wh, what...!?
　How'd you know we were coming!」

stage0052_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$隼人$$
「Call it animal instinct.
　Still a wild beast of a man, as ever」

stage0052_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Quit yapping about nonsense
　and hand over the Getter already!」

stage0052_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, $$インベーダー#keyword$$!
　This is Shin Getter!!」

stage0052_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Three machines split apart and combined...!」

stage0052_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$アマタ$$
「That robot...!
　It's got the same system as Aquarion!」

stage0052_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Perfect timing.
　As expected of the Getter Team」

stage0052_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$キタン$$
「Then let's show them
　some outstanding teamwork too!」

stage0052_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「OK, $$キタン$$.
　Let's introduce ourselves to $c's new faces too」

stage0052_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, let's go!
　We can't let the giant $$インベーダー#keyword$$
　run loose!」

stage0052_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Can't lose to the old guys either!」

stage0052_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$キタン$$
「Hey, $$ワッ太$$!
　Don't go calling us old guys!」

stage0052_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't bother, $$キタン$$.
　To shut a kid up, you've gotta show
　him what grown-ups can really do」

stage0052_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$キタン$$
「Right!
　Then I'll show you the power of
　my $$スペースキングキタン$$, built for space combat!」

stage0052_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「And the $$スペースヨーコＷタンク$$ too!」

stage0052_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Here we come, $$インベーダー#keyword$$!
　We'll make sure you know Earth has us!!」

stage0052_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「The $$インベーダー#keyword$$'s attack...
　This has become quite the problem」

stage0052_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「During the $$再世戦争$$ it was fought on Mars,
　but if a giant-class $$インベーダー#keyword$$ hits Earth
　directly, it'll be chaos」

stage0052_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$刹那$$
「Once the dimensional boundary is fixed,
　they likely can't shift to Earth anymore,
　but that means the end of humanity's history...」

stage0052_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「If the $$インベーダー#keyword$$s ever notice that,
　they'll invade to claim Earth as their nest
　before the Prison of Time is complete」

stage0052_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$隼人$$
「Heh... humanity now stands at the brink of despair」

stage0052_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$弁慶$$
「Do you even get the situation?」

stage0052_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$竜馬$$
「If $$インベーダー#keyword$$s come, I'll crush them.
　As for $$エタニティ・フラット$$, I just need to
　corner Geminis before the boundary locks.」

stage0052_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$隼人$$
「I'm in, $$竜馬$$.
　That's why we unsealed Shin Getter, after all.」

stage0052_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$弁慶$$
「Yeah!
　I'm not so resigned I'd sit and wait for the end.」

stage0052_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$竜馬$$
「That's right, $$インベーダー#keyword$$.
　Come on, if you're coming.」

stage0052_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$竜馬$$
「I just fight as my heart commands.」

stage0052_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$竜馬$$
「My training journey wasn't just for show.」

stage0052_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$隼人$$
「Hard to believe it ended at a Japanese high school.」

stage0052_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't laugh.
　Even there, I've had some pretty
　exciting days of my own!」

stage0052_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Thought I'd gone rusty playing
　researcher. Guess I worried for nothing.」

stage0052_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$隼人$$
「That's right.
　I'm not old enough to need your concern.」

stage0052_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$弁慶$$
「There he goes, $$隼人$$ acting cool again...!」

stage0052_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$隼人$$
「Heh... if showing what I can do
　makes me pretentious, so be it. I won't change.」

stage0052_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$弁慶$$
「How about that!
　My arm's still not too shabby, huh!」

stage0052_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Honestly, I'm surprised.
　Thought you'd retired to babysit $$號$$ and the rest.」

stage0052_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$隼人$$
「Keep up with that trio of his,
　and you'll get moving whether you like it or not.」

stage0052_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$弁慶$$
「Exactly!
　I'm staying in the game till $$渓$$'s married off!」

stage0052_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$竜馬$$
（What's this uneasy feeling...
　Is it the $$インベーダー#keyword$$s' doing...）

stage0052_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$竜馬$$
（No, that's not it...!
　Something that'll change my fate is
　about to happen! It's setting my body ablaze!）

stage0052_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Shin Getter!
　If you've been calling out to me,
　then answer my fighting spirit!」

stage0052_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's do this!
　I'll crush every last enemy we have!!」

stage0052_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$隼人$$
「Coming back to Earth, lesson unlearned,
　seems your brains never caught up with evolution.」

stage0052_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$隼人$$
「You'll pay that price with your lives!」

stage0052_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$弁慶$$
「Come on, $$インベーダー#keyword$$!
　Don't think you'll get past us while we stand!」

stage0052_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$弁慶$$
「That blue star
　is not something we'll hand to scum like you!!」

stage0052_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Fighting grotesque freaks isn't my style, but oh well.」

stage0052_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$スズネ$$
「What's wrong, $n!
　The enemy's right in front of you!」

stage0052_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$キタン$$
「Been a while since real combat, and
　it's the $$インベーダー#keyword$$s?! Rough break!」

stage0052_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「You say that, but you look happy about it.」

stage0052_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$キタン$$
「Well, yeah.
　Turns out I'm better suited to this
　than sitting behind some desk!」

stage0052_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Honestly, I thought I'd never
　have to use a rifle again...」

stage0052_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「But I've got a reason to fight!
　I have to protect the future of
　the kids who believe in us!」

stage0052_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$キタン$$
「Alright!
　Let's do our best, Teacher 《$$ヨマコ$$》!」

stage0052_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Here we come, $$インベーダー#keyword$$!
　Now that we're here, you're done for!」

stage0052_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$ギミー$$
「Let's do this, $$ダリー$$!
　Let's show $$キタン$$ and $$ヨーコ$$
　how much we've grown!」

stage0052_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ダリー$$
「In $$ギミー$$'s case, isn't it that
　you're scared of messing up in front of $$隼人$$?」

stage0052_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ダリー$$
「Heh heh... seems like habits
　from childhood are hard to break.」

stage0052_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ギミー$$
「That ends today!
　I told $$竜馬$$ I'm a full-fledged
　pilot now, so I'll prove it!」

stage0052_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ダリー$$
「Got it!
　I'll be right behind you!」

stage0052_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$シモン$$
「Space-type Gunmen keep getting finished too.」

stage0052_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Just as expected of $$ロシウ$$ and $$リーロン$$.
　No mistake in leaving it to them.」

stage0052_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$シモン$$
「Of course.
　They're the ones I put my trust in.」

stage0052_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Then, $$シモン$$!
　You know what we've got to do!」

stage0052_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$シモン$$
「Yeah!
　Anyone messing with Earth, we'll smash!!」
